tiers.name: ULTRA MEGA
tiers.note: head-counts read bare on ULTRA MEGA: the solo sheet's own numbers (the client's count helper skips the raid curve's ×1.8 at this tier), ×6.61 for a ten-seat night

damageLaw: Five kinds of hit. HP hits (the sprinter, the pterodactyl, the bruiser, the dilophosaurus on ULTRA MEGA, the triceratops on Sarge and the heroes) grow with the tier (15 · 30 · 45 · 60 · 65 HP for a bite, double for a slam) and land at 50 % off the man's sheet HP (the damper). Priced hits (the stegosaurus' boulder, King Rex's bite; KOs until v29.70) take 22.5 HP on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD, 31.5 on MEGA and ULTRA MEGA, whole. The floor (since v31.00, EASY to MEGA): a hit that would empty the full bar of anyone but a rifleman leaves him on 15 % of it and the next one fells him; ULTRA MEGA has no floor. Fire (since v31.00, EASY to MEGA): a beat of the dilophosaurus or King Rex is a light front and a burn on the man, all whole; the fire rows count breaths (2 beats and the burn they leave). The triceratops' charge (since v32.16) KOs a light man in one hit at any level, and takes 70 % of a heavy's bar at or over the tier's line (EASY and MEDIUM have none; HARD 60, MEGA and ULTRA MEGA 80), a KO under it. Bar hits (the spitter's glob, the king's hop and tail, his fire on ULTRA MEGA) take a share of his bar of 5–7 bar hits at level 20, each landing at 90 % + 10 % × bar ÷ HP since v28.65 and at 50 % since the damper (v29.17); a man who takes no hit for 4 s mends. Since v31.95 (THE MINIONS SOAK) every dinosaur's body from EASY to MEGA is a set number of rounds of your rifleman at your commander level (the lab: level 20); the dinosaurs' hits are as they were.
headlines: Since v29.70 nothing in this fight is an instant KO but the triceratops' charge on a light man (v32.16, Wyatt's word): the stegosaurus' boulder and King Rex's bite take 22.5 HP on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD, 31.5 on MEGA and ULTRA MEGA, whole. On EASY to MEGA no other single hit fells a man other than a rifleman from a full bar (he stands on 15 %), one blow reaches at most 3 · 4 · 4 · 5 men, and fire burns (a light front, then a burn on the man). Since v28.65 the damage changes with difficulty: the sprinter's bite and the pterodactyl's dive hit for 15 · 30 · 45 · 60 · 65 HP (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA · ULTRA MEGA), the bruiser's slam for double (30 · 60 · 90 · 120 · 130 HP).

Body HP: the triceratops went 12 → 36 and the dilophosaurus 7 → 21 at the base, so every tier's bodies are three times as tough; since v31.95 (THE MINIONS SOAK) a body on EASY to MEGA is a set number of rounds of your rifleman at your commander level instead (a triceratops 30 · 45 · 60 · 75 rounds: 69 · 103 · 138 · 172 HP at the lab's level 20; a sprinter 2 · 3 · 4 · 5: 5 · 7 · 9 · 11 HP); ULTRA MEGA's guard trikes are 570 HP.

THE BOSS LAB fights King Rex at level 20 on every tier: Sarge with the saber, the scout jeep and 9 men at rank 20 (rifleman, M. gunner, bazooka, mortar, medic, flame, sweeper, radio man, grenadier). A bite lands 7.5 · 15 · 22.5 · 30 · 32.5 HP (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA · ULTRA MEGA, the damper's 50 %): one bite KOs no stock man on EASY, the rifleman from MEDIUM and the M. gunner, mortar, medic, sweeper, radio man and grenadier on ULTRA MEGA (and the spy, a tap away); the bazooka, flame and commando live through it on every tier.

A slam lands 15 · 30 · 45 · 60 · 65 HP: one slam KOs the rifleman from EASY and the M. gunner, bazooka, mortar, medic, flame, sweeper, radio man and grenadier on ULTRA MEGA (and the commando and spy, a tap away). One dilophosaurus breath (2 beats and the burn they leave) lands 8.2 · 11 · 14.8 · 18.5 · 45 HP (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA · ULTRA MEGA): it KOs no stock man on EASY, the medic from MEDIUM, the rifleman, mortar, sweeper and radio man from HARD (and the spy, a tap away) and the M. gunner and grenadier on ULTRA MEGA; the bazooka, flame and commando live through it on every tier.

The king's fire: one breath (2 beats and the burn they leave) takes 24 · 30.5 · 37 · 48 HP whole on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA: at level 20 on EASY one breath KOs every man of the army but the M. gunner (2), the bazooka (3), the flame (3), the commando (3), the shotgun Sarge (3) and the Claymore Sarge (3); on ULTRA MEGA (100 bar hits a beat, landing at 50 %) one breath KOs every man and hero but Quick Draw Croak (2).

The triceratops' charge (since v32.16): a light man is KO'd in one hit at any level on every tier; a heavy (bazooka, commando, flame, grenadier) takes 70 % of his bar and stands on EASY and MEDIUM, on HARD from level 60, on MEGA and ULTRA MEGA from level 80 (under the line: KO).

Bar hits (the campaign's hit counter): a level-20 man's bar is 5 to 7 bar hits; one bar hit is about a sixth of his HP (2.2 HP of a rifleman's 14, 8.3 of a flame's 55); since v28.65 a bar hit lands at 90 % + 10 % × bar ÷ HP, and since v29.17 at 50 % of that from an enemy (the damper).

King Rex's bars with one commander: court 790 · 1,009 · 1,507 · 4,185 · 15,000, angry 790 · 1,098 · 1,651 · 22,928 · 15,000 (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA · ULTRA MEGA); on EASY to MEGA each extra commander adds 0.9 of the solo bar; ULTRA MEGA is flat for any party since v29.45.

changes.what: The sprinter's bite, the pterodactyl's dive and the triceratops' charge stop being KOs: they hit for 15 · 30 · 45 · 60 · 65 HP on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA · ULTRA MEGA. The bruiser's slam hits for double (30 · 60 · 90 · 120 · 130 HP). The dilophosaurus burns 50 HP a second on MEDIUM, HARD and MEGA and 90 on ULTRA MEGA (EASY as before: 1 bar hit a beat). The boulder and King Rex's bite stay KOs.

Body HP ×3: triceratops 12 → 36 HP and dilophosaurus 7 → 21 HP at the base, so every tier's body is three times as tough until v31.95 (since THE MINIONS SOAK a body on EASY to MEGA is a set number of rounds of your rifleman instead: the CARD-SOK row) (the ULTRA MEGA guard's trikes 570 HP).

ONE HP NUMBER: your man's HP is the number on his unit sheet in every mode (the same one the battleground uses). The older hits that count in bar hits (the spitter, the king's fire, his hop and tail) land a little lighter on tough men: 90 % + 10 % × bar ÷ HP of a hit.
THE CLUTCH: every clutch (the eruption's nests, the last eruption) lands one egg every 0.2 s a nest, side by side, each still hatching on its old moment.

TENTH-RANK HP (with CARD-LRB): extra HP every 10 ranks: M. gunner +1, bazooka +10, grenadier +4, flame +6, commando +10, spy +1. At level 20 the flame and the commando have 55 HP and lived through a MEDIUM bite with 25 HP until the damper (no class did on Oct 30).
THE BOMBER: your bomber flies in every boss fight now and aims at the thickest knot of dinos (or the king). Price and damage unchanged.
KING CROAK, YOUR HERO: King Croak on your side is tougher: his bar starts at 131 (was 31), and at level 20 he stands with 169 HP and a bar of 146 (the heroes' rows of WHO SURVIVES).

THE DAMPER: every enemy blow on your men lands at 50 % in the campaign and the boss fights (50 % off on every tier, a row in the Boss Lab's RULES): a 15 HP bite lands 7.5, the king's fire beat 5 of its 10 bar hits; a KO (the boulder, King Rex's bite) is still a KO. A man stands about twice the blows he did, and WHO SURVIVES and THE LEVEL A MAN FIRST SURVIVES count it.

READ AGAIN ON v29.51 after the day's cards: King Rex's bars for one commander on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD follow the designers' time-to-kill chart (CARD-RXT, v29.37: the court 790 · 1,009 · 1,507, the angry return 790 · 1,098 · 1,651) and on MEGA the player-damage-threshold pass's number (CARD-PDT: 4,185 · 4,586); the men's tenth-rank HP moved (CARD-FLT, v29.40: the flame's rungs through level 50 tripled; CARD-DHP, v29.41: the bazooka's and commando's doubled): at level 20 the flame 55 HP, the bazooka 33, the commando 41. WHO SURVIVES and THE LEVEL A MAN FIRST SURVIVES count it.

ULTRA MEGA HP: King Rex's two bars are flat for any party on ULTRA MEGA: 15,000 the court and 15,000 the angry return with one commander and with ten (each extra commander added 0.9 of the solo bar there before). EASY to MEGA keep the party law.

THE MINIONS SOAK: from EASY to MEGA every dinosaur's body is a set number of rounds of your rifleman at your commander level (the Boss Lab: its level 20; a party of two or more: level 35, 75 on MEGA): a sprinter 2 · 3 · 4 · 5, a pterodactyl 2 · 3 · 4 · 5, a spitter 4 · 6 · 8 · 10, an egg 3 · 4 · 6 · 8, a bruiser 12 · 18 · 24 · 30, a triceratops 30 · 45 · 60 · 75, a stegosaurus 10 · 15 · 20 · 25, a dilophosaurus 20 · 30 · 40 · 50 rounds (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA). One round of a level-20 rifleman is 2.29 HP, so at the lab's level the bodies are a sprinter 5 · 7 · 9 · 11 HP (was 1 · 1 · 2 · 2), a pterodactyl 5 · 7 · 9 · 11 HP (was 2 · 3 · 4 · 5), a spitter 9 · 14 · 18 · 23 HP (was 5 · 8 · 11 · 13), an egg 7 · 9 · 14 · 18 HP (was 4 · 6 · 9 · 11), a bruiser 28 · 41 · 55 · 69 HP (was 12 · 18 · 26 · 32), a triceratops 69 · 103 · 138 · 172 HP (was 36 · 54 · 79 · 95), a stegosaurus 23 · 34 · 46 · 57 HP (was 10 · 15 · 22 · 26), a dilophosaurus 46 · 69 · 92 · 115 HP (was 21 · 32 · 46 · 55) (the 'was' is the dashboard's read of v29.45); an egg's hatchling is born with the same number, and so are the eruption's pours and clutches. ULTRA MEGA keeps the night's own bodies (the ×0.25 / ×0.5 and the king's guard). The dinosaurs' hits are as they were: this card gives them staying power, not teeth. The cells live in the Boss Lab's RULES (two rows for the lair: the rounds and the party's level), editable there like every rule.

NO INSTANT KO + THE HEAVY CLASS: nothing in a boss fight is an instant KO any more: the stegosaurus' boulder and King Rex's bite (KOs on the v29.51 page) take 90 % of the M. gunner's HP at the chart's rank for the lair's level, 22.5 HP on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD, 31.5 on MEGA and ULTRA MEGA, landing whole (the damper does not take its half). At level 20 that KOs the rifleman (14 HP) and leaves the M. gunner 2.5 of his 25 HP on EASY to HARD and the flame 32.5. The heavy class: the commando, the flame and the bazooka carry max(their own HP, twice the M. gunner's) on the sheet every dino hit reads: at level 20 the commando 50 HP (was 41), the bazooka 50 (was 33), the flame 55 (his own); their bars are not touched.

changes.what: RAZIYA'S BOSS NOTES: THE FLOOR: no single hit fells a man other than a rifleman from a full bar: the hit that would leaves him on 15 % of it and the next one fells him (a rifleman still falls to one; a burn is not held back). THE CAP: one blow reaches at most 3 · 4 · 4 · 5 men. FIRE BURNS: the dilophosaurus' beat is a light front of 1.5 · 2 · 3 · 4 HP and a burn on the man of 1.5 · 2 · 2.5 · 3 HP a second for 3 s; King Rex's a front of 3 · 4 · 5 · 6 HP and a burn of 4 · 5 · 6 · 8 HP a second for 4 s; all of it whole (was: the dilophosaurus 1 bar hit a beat on EASY and 25 HP a beat from MEDIUM, the king 10 bar hits a beat, both at the damper's half). Also: a green dino rests 0.8 · 0.7 · 0.6 · 0.5 s after a bite, a pterodactyl's dive ends on its first man, a bazooka hits the triceratops like a hull and he crawls 0.6 · 0.6 · 0.5 · 0.5 s after each man he runs over, every dino pays ×1.4 dog tags, the nests deal one after another and King Rex does not leap while an egg stands.

Also: the lair's floor is volcanic dirt; at phase 2 he leaps to the far end instead of vanishing; MEGA phase 2: the clutch eggs and every hatchling ×2, the angry King Rex ×5 (his MEGA bar 22,928, was 4,586).

questions.text: "Level 20" is the Boss Lab's own King Rex level and stock army. THE LEVEL A MAN FIRST SURVIVES table covers every rank. Should another reference level stand beside it (for example the campaign level where players first meet the lair)?

A balance read for Raziya, not a bug: at the lab's level 20, one bite from MEDIUM up and one slam on any tier KO almost every man. Only the flame and the commando (31 HP) live through a MEDIUM bite, with 1 HP. LRB-Q6 flagged the same.
"Bar hits" is the page's word for the campaign's hit counter, so the team never reads the code's old name for it.

notes: A unit's HP is the body the sheet fields on that tier, as the game spawns it (measured in the proof). ULTRA MEGA wears the night's ×0.25 / ×0.5 on the swarm, and the king's guard (the trikes and the bruisers the sheet pins) keeps the full bar: for those two the HP shown is the guard's bar and the small "swarm" number under it the swarm's / a hatched egg's body (the unit's note says how many of the sheet's bodies are the guard). The head-count is the bodies named in the solo wave sheet (one commander), eggs counted as eggs and hatching into more; ULTRA MEGA's counts are the bare sheet, ×6.61 for a ten-seat night.

WHO SURVIVES counts hits of that strike in a row (inside the 4 s mend) that KO a fresh man at the lab's level 20 (KO = one hit), each hit landing at 50 % since the damper (v29.17); the floor counted on EASY to MEGA (a non-rifleman needs two hits from a full bar); the boulder and the king's bite are the price, whole; the dilo's and the king's fire count BREATHS (2 beats and the burn they leave, run out: a breath that comes before the burn is out renews it, so a man can last a little longer than the count); the triceratops' charge is the KO of a light man and 2 for a heavy at or over the line. A dot in a cell's corner marks a man the proof hit on the real machines (Chrome for Testing + WebKit); the other cells are the read's arithmetic.

THE LEVEL A MAN FIRST SURVIVES ONE HIT is the lowest rank (0–100) at which a fresh man's sheet HP is more than one hit as it lands (50 % of it since the damper; no gifts, soul or gear); for the dilo's fire breath the hit is one whole breath (2 beats and the burn they leave); on EASY to MEGA every man but the rifleman lives through one hit at any rank (0: the floor), the triceratops' charge KOs a light man at any rank (never) and spares a heavy from the tier's line; never = not by rank 100. Sarge's rows read the iron at the same rank as the man.

The king's HP per tier is his court bar with one commander, and the second number under it the angry return's; THE BOSS shows both bars (THE COURT · THE ANGRY RETURN) by the number of commanders (1 · 2 · 3 · 4 · 5 · 10) as the game builds the sheet; on ULTRA MEGA the sheet reads the same two numbers at every party size since v29.45 (CARD-UMH).

The lab's army (the line under the fight's name) is the Boss Lab's own seats, one of each class in THE PLATOON at the lab's level, read out of the lab after its launch on every tier, with the iron Sarge wears; the spy and the commando are a tap away.

A picture over 60 KB as the game encodes it is carried re-encoded when that fits (the same drawing): STEGOSAURUS, DILOPHOSAURUS, MGUNNER, SARGE. Still over the cap, it is a PNG of the same sprite, 240 px tall or the largest of 180/140 that fits: SPRINTER (47 KB PNG, 240 px tall, for a 167 KB SVG), SPITTER (48 KB PNG, 240 px tall, for a 81 KB SVG), BRUISER (47 KB PNG, 240 px tall, for a 157 KB SVG), KING REX (52 KB PNG, 240 px tall, for a 105 KB SVG), KING YETI as a hero on your side (41 KB PNG, 180 px tall, for a 97 KB SVG), KING REX as a hero on your side (52 KB PNG, 240 px tall, for a 105 KB SVG), KING CROAK as a hero on your side (46 KB PNG, 180 px tall, for a 310 KB SVG), JANE as a hero on your side (53 KB PNG, 240 px tall, for a 117 KB SVG), EMPEROR BEAR as a hero on your side (57 KB PNG, 240 px tall, for a 277 KB SVG), PRINCESS CROAK as a hero on your side (40 KB PNG, 180 px tall, for a 332 KB SVG). Dropped: RIFLEMAN (76 KB), BAZOOKA (73 KB), MORTAR (92 KB), MEDIC (80 KB), FLAME (83 KB), MINESWEEPER (72 KB), RADIOMAN (75 KB), GRENADIER (82 KB), COMMANDO (75 KB), SPY (75 KB).
